title: Tijuana, Baja California — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Tijuana, Baja California: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Tijuana is a city in Baja California with a population of 2,022,534. Bustling border city with a dynamic food scene, cultural fusion, and strong manufacturing economy. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
